Kimi-K3.1-Pro is the first model in Moonshot AI's new K3.1 series and its most capable 3T-class open-weight model to date. It is a post-trained version of Kimi K3 with substantially larger post-training compute, featuring a 1-million-token context window and native visual understanding (text and image input, text output). Through large-scale joint reinforcement learning across hundreds of downstream domains, it delivers significant gains in coding, 3D creation, financial research, and other long-horizon agentic tasks: scoring 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, achieving a state-of-the-art 64.4 on OfficeQA Pro v2, and reducing claim-level hallucination rate from 23.4% (K3) to 8.3%. Its overall intelligence approaches leading closed-source frontier models.

It adopts a Causal Encoder-Decoder asymmetric design with 8B active parameters for input and 16B for output, and offers native multimodal visual understanding. KV Cache usage is cut to one-quarter of the previous generation's HBM and one-eighth of its SSD storage, dramatically lowering costs for long-context and agentic workloads. With a 1M-token context window and up to 384K-token maximum output, it balances high throughput, low latency, and exceptional cost efficiency.
